text: rivers dried up, forests became graveyards. It's estimated that the total human population
shrank to fewer than 3,000 individuals, a genetic bottleneck so tight that every person alive today
likely descends from that tiny handful of survivors. No crops, no animals, no sunlight,
no second chances. Imagine spending your entire life in darkness, freezing, starving,
with the constant fear that today might simply be the last day anyone sees the sun.
And yet, somehow, against all odds, a few stubborn, desperate humans managed to endure.
You exist because they didn't give up when everything else did.
